$Comment: A boss's volley, for any fight in this pack: every Interval seconds a warning ring lights under
each player near the fight and a bomb drops onto it (the game's own Gobliterator falling-burst
pattern, its player drops only). Put it in a phase's behavior slot, or inside a phase macro of
your own, with the Interaction a boss drops; that root should fall from high above the ring, so
the ring is a player's cue to move.
Interval is the wait between volleys, BurstDuration how long each volley keeps dropping, and
DropDelay the wait between one player's drops inside it. The flag and timer names are this
macro's own bookkeeping: give each copy in one fight its own names, and clear the flags when
the fight resets so the next try starts fresh.

Interval.Description: Seconds between volleys, as a [min, max] range rolled each time.

Interaction.Description: The root interaction dropped at each player's feet. It should fall from above, so the warning ring gives the player time.

TelegraphParticle.Description: The warning ring lit on the ground under each player as the drop starts.

Range.Description: How far from the fight's own entity a player may stand and still be a target.

DropDelay.Description: Seconds between one player's drops inside a volley; the first falls at once.

ArmedFlag.Description: Flag set once the interval has started. Give each copy its own name.

IntervalTimer.Description: Timer holding the wait to the next volley. Give each copy its own name.

VolleyFlag.Description: Flag that starts one volley. Give each copy its own name.

RunningFlag.Description: Flag marking a volley in progress. Give each copy its own name.

BurstTimer.Description: Timer holding a volley's length. Give each copy its own name.

WaveTimer.Description: Timer the falling-burst macro paces its point waves with (unused here). Give each copy its own name.

PlayerTimer.Description: Timer pacing the drops on players. Give each copy its own name.

Instructions.$Comment: Starts the wait to the first volley the first time this runs.
Each time the wait runs out, starts a volley and the next wait.
